workflows.title: Create an account
workflows.permissions: Guest (no auth). Self-selectable modes: customer, helper, business_owner.

workflows.title: Switch between customer, helper, business and other modes
workflows.permissions: Authenticated. Self-selectable: customer, helper, business_owner. Granted (membership required): business_manager, business_representative, business_employee, business_support_agent. Admin mode reserved for admin roles.

workflows.title: Complete helper or business onboarding
workflows.permissions: Authenticated. Listing, bidding and starting work enforce onboarding server-side.

workflows.title: Manage account settings
featureFlags: LAUNCH_SETTINGS_TABS (profile, security, businesses, notifications, privacy, account, danger, tax)

workflows.title: Privacy controls, data export, account deletion
workflows.permissions: Guest for public policy pages; authenticated for export/deletion.

workflows.title: Get help and track support tickets
serverHandlers: POST /api/support/public/conversations (+ verify, resend-code, messages, review, reopen, download)
workflows.permissions: Guest for public conversations (code-verified); authenticated for tickets.

workflows.title: Find helpers and services
workflows.permissions: Guest can browse the directory; sign-in required to book.
featureFlags: discoverEverything: false (full 'everything' scope not launched; Discover page exists)

workflows.title: Book a helper, business, or service slot
workflows.permissions: Authenticated; requireEmailVerified and requireTermsAcceptance on booking creation.

workflows.title: Message about a job or booking

workflows.permissions: Authenticated; food tracking token is guest-accessible.

workflows.permissions: Guest can request and look up by code; authenticated for detail.

workflows.title: Manage your helper profile and public listing
workflows.permissions: Authenticated for edits; public profile is guest-visible.

workflows.title: Browse open jobs
workflows.permissions: Guest can browse; authenticated for saved searches; sign-in plus completed onboarding to bid.

workflows.title: Work assigned jobs and incoming bookings
Create and send invoices
workflows.permissions: Authenticated helper; public token link is guest-viewable.

workflows.title: Receive payouts
workflows.permissions: Authenticated helper; tax-identity (W-9) gate on withdrawals.

workflows.title: View your earnings overview
workflows.condition: The Earnings tab on the helper dashboard is visible only while the helperEarnings launch flag is enabled (it is off by default). Your payouts at /helper/payouts and your earnings statements at /helper-earnings/statements stay available while the tab is hidden.
serverHandlers: earnings via payout and statement APIs

workflows.title: Set up your business
workflows.permissions: Launch submit is public (rate-limited); status views authenticated.

workflows.title: Manage team members and roles
workflows.permissions: Authenticated; bizIdAccess capability checks per business.

workflows.title: Submit specialized intake requests (maintenance, trades, beauty, creative, professional, continuity)
workflows.condition: Specialized intake requests require the specializedProfileTemplates launch flag, which is off by default. While it is off, the intake entry buttons are hidden on business profile pages and the public intake API returns 404. The hub intake triage tabs (beauty-ops, creative-ops, continuity-ops, professional-ops, trades-ops, maintenance) are already registered so they appear automatically at launch.
workflows.permissions: Guest can open the pages; submission blocked while gated.

workflows.permissions: Guest can browse and quote; authenticated to order; checkRestrictions('checkout') on payment.

workflows.permissions: Kitchen page behind auth; queue board is public.

workflows.title: Hand off pickup and delivery orders
workflows.permissions: Guest via tracking token; runner actions authenticated.

workflows.title: Request refunds on restaurant credit and orders
Use POS, inventory, crew, and runner tools
Use OxSteed Credit (top-ups, transfers, withdrawals, cards)
workflows.condition: OxSteed Credit requires the oxsteed_credit_enabled feature flag. It is ON in production as of 2026-10-11. If the rail is off, the page shows "OxSteed Credit is temporarily paused" and spending, top-ups, and withdrawals stay paused while balances and history remain visible.
workflows.permissions: Authenticated; checkRestrictions('checkout') and rate limiters on money movement.

If the rail is off, the page shows "OxSteed Credit is temporarily paused" and spending, top-ups, and withdrawals stay paused while balances and history remain visible.
